description: Gives the total distance driven on all roads in one GB council area each year, in million vehicle miles (and vehicle km), for all motor vehicles and for cars and taxis, plus the area's road length, newest year first. Answers "how much traffic is there in Leeds and is it growing" for council officers, net-zero and carbon plans, and consultants comparing areas. Minor-road traffic is a DfT estimate; this endpoint does not split vans, HGVs or buses (use region_traffic_by_vehicle_type for that at region level). (cost: 1 credit)

local_authority_id.description: integer, required, DfT local authority id (from traffic_local_authority_find, e.g. Leeds is 63)

year.description: integer, optional, a single year; default is the most recent years

years.description: integer, optional, how many recent years when year is not given, 1-40, default 10

name: local_authority_traffic_totals
